title: Role mappings
intro: Rules map identity-provider claim values to team roles. Rules loaded from the rules file are managed and read-only.
patternHelp: The pattern is matched against the values of the chosen claim, split on "/". Each "*" matches exactly one whole segment and is captured in order as $1, $2, and so on. Example: /teams/*/members.
teamHelp: Slug of the target team. May use captures, for example $1. Rules for teams that do not exist are skipped.

vendors.title: Vendors
vendors.intro: The shared vendor list. Items and vendor orders pick vendors from here.
vendors.name: Name
vendors.aliasesHelp: One per line. Names and aliases must be unique across vendors.

rates.title: Reference rates
rates.intro: Reference rates convert other currencies into the base currency ({{base}}) for estimates, and provisionally for vendor orders that have no actual charge yet.
rates.invalid: A positive number with at most 6 decimals.
rates.deleteBody: Estimates in {{currency}} are not converted into the base currency until a new rate is set.
